title: Koala wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#8c9aa8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='80' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#76838f'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='80' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#76838f'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='96' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#5f6b78'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='96' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#5f6b78'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='26' fill='#9fb0bf'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='13' fill='#9fb0bf'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='30' r='13' fill='#9fb0bf'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='8' fill='#e3c9d4'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='30' r='8' fill='#e3c9d4'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#cdd8e0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='46' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3b2a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='46' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3b2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='6.5' ry='8' fill='#4a3a48'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='57' r='4' fill='#e8a7b8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='57' r='4' fill='#e8a7b8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 64 Q50 69 56 64' stroke='#4a3a48' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M36 26 L50 2 L64 26 Z' fill='#f2545b'/>
  <path d='M36 26 L50 2 L57 26 Z' fill='#f9a03f'/>
  <path d='M50 2 L57 26 L64 26 Z' fill='#f2545b'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M41 20 L59 20' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='3.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
